newsitem.title: USA: Drug store chain says ads not anti-black.
newsitem.headline: Drug store chain says ads not anti-black.

text.p: Walgreen Drug Stores said Monday a Black History Month flyer it distributed that included a coupon for skin lightening cream was standard advertising that blacks should not find offensive.
"There was no attempt to offend anyone," company spokesman Tom Mammoser said.
The item in question was a Black History Month booklet that featured coupons for a variety of products, including a skin lightening cream.

Mammoser told Reuters the nationwide drug store chain received a media inquiry from California questioning the appropriateness of advertising the cream in the history month booklet but had received no complaints from consumers.

"We've been publishing this booklet for five years now," he said. "We've been selling this particular product for more than 25 years. What's being offered are products with high frequency of purchase in the black community."
The coupon book was distributed nationally.
